result.title: DocSEAM: Bidirectional Cross-Page Encoding for Multi-Page Document Understanding
result.summary: Multi-page document vision-language models encode each page independently, creating a feature-level discontinuity at page boundaries: visual tokens are formed without access to content on adjacent pages, and the language model must reason over these page representations formed in isolation. We introduce DocSEAM (Document Selective Enrichment via Anchored Masking), a lightweight module inserted between a pretrained vision encoder and the language model that injects the inductive bias of local cross-page context into visual representations. For each page, DocSEAM forms a local triplet with its two neighbors, applies center-anchored masked self-attention with directional salience gates to fuse information from neighbor pages, and returns only the enriched center-page tokens, leaving the visual token count unchanged. After a supervised cross-page warm-up and multi-page fine-tuning with DocSEAM frozen, our 9B-parameter model achieves state-of-the-art results among the evaluated open-weight models of up to 10B parameters on five multi-page document VQA benchmarks. We further show that under controlled re-pagination, DocSEAM reduces sensitivity to boundary placement and improves cross-page span localization

AI.brief_summary: DocSEAM 在预训练视觉编码器与语言模型之间插入轻量模块，将每页与前后两页组成局部三元组，用中心锚定的掩码自注意力和方向性显著门控融合邻页信息，只返回增强后的中心页 token，并在五个多页文档 VQA 基准上验证，另用受控重分页实验分析页边界敏感性与跨页片段定位。
AI.relevance_reason: 其在不增加视觉 token 数的前提下把邻页视觉证据写入进入 LM 的表示，可供核查 LVR 中固定预算下视觉证据筛选与状态增强的做法；但该模块服务于文档理解任务，未涉及 latent 推理轨迹的生成与使用，借鉴属推测。
